laws.rule: Mount Yasur (Tanna) can only be visited with a licensed official guide, in groups; book through accommodation or a travel agency. Access is managed locally and can close when volcanic activity rises; follow the guide's instructions at the rim.
laws.heading: Tanna, Mount Yasur; FAQ

laws.rule: The Giant Banyan Tree at Leitouapam is village-owned; the village charges VUV 1,500 an adult and VUV 700 a child, children under four free (no RBA rate for VUV).
laws.heading: See the Giant Banyan Tree in Leitouapam

local-law.note: Tanna only. No official Mount Yasur entry fee is published by the tourism office, so none is recorded.

dress_and_conduct: Travellers are welcome in Tanna's kastom villages (such as Yakel, Ikunala and Imaio) but are advised to visit with a local guide.
sacred_or_restricted_places: Mount Yasur: only with an official guide; no safety rails or viewing platforms.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Village and kastom communities; the Giant Banyan Tree is owned by Leitouapam village.
